summary.text: Wilford Carter is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 34, which covers Calcasieu Parish, and was first elected in 2019. His official House page lists him on the Civil Law and Procedure, House and Governmental Affairs, and Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Carter's occupation as attorney.
It lists his education as a J.D. from the Southern University Law Center and accounting study at McNeese State University.
He is also listed in the Acadiana Delegation, the Democratic Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus.

sources.title: Wilford Dan Carter, Sr., District 34 (Louisiana House of Representatives)
